title: Retail Installment Contracts: Signing a Hardship Extension Agreement
content:
**Policy entry.** When the borrower of an active contract under Retail Installment Contracts asks to defer installments, the hardship extension agreement fixes how many installments it defers. The borrower signs the agreement for that number of installments, and the signing date is the date the borrower signs it.

## Capability

`sign_extension_agreement_772d986b` is the borrower's own signing action on an open hardship extension agreement. One call records the borrower's signature on that agreement, sets the installments it defers, and moves the agreement from awaiting signature to signed; the borrower can see the signed agreement and its signature time. Signing commits the borrower to the number of installments named; it does not apply the extension to the contract.

## How it is invoked

This is the customer's own tool. The representative unlocks `sign_extension_agreement_772d986b` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to sign; the representative does not sign on the borrower's behalf.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contract_id` | the contract reference number of the retail installment contract the agreement is for, as returned by the contract lookup | text identifier |
| `service_request_id` | the reference number of the borrower's open extension agreement awaiting signature on that contract, as returned by the servicing-request lookup | text identifier |
| `requested_extension_months` | the installments the agreement defers | an integer count of installments, a whole number with no decimals; 0 when not applicable |

## Return

A receipt rendered as text with `service_request_id` (the agreement signed), `contract_id` (the contract it covers), `requested_extension_months` (installments the signed agreement defers, integer), `request_status` (the text signed, meaning the borrower's signature is recorded) and `signed_at` (the signature time in the same date-time format the system clock reports). A receipt showing the agreement as signed means the signature is on file.

**Q&A.** *Does the signature move the due dates?* No. The tool records the signature and the number of installments; the agreement then stands as signed and not yet applied.
